messages:
marta: Quick design review — trying a compact streaming control for the Playground. Idea: icon-only pause/resume on the right edge of the message while keeping a text 'Regenerate' as the primary action. Mock here: https://figma.com/s/compact-stream-control :eyes:
kevin: Nice direction. Concern: discoverability. Icon-only can be missed -> maybe add a subtle pulsing hint on first use or a tooltip 'Pause streaming' on hover. Also needs clear visual state for paused vs streaming.
jamie: Accessibility nit: tooltip isn't enough. Control must be keyboard-focusable, have aria-pressed, and trigger an ARIA announcement when state changes. Also ensure focus ring meets contrast.
dennis: From infra side, pausing maps to existing `pause_stream` API flag, so backend's fine. Question: if user pauses then regenerates, do we restart or resume? Need explicit behaviour.
marta: Good point. Proposal: regenerate = restart generation from scratch; pause = hold current stream position and allow resume. We'll add microcopy in the tooltip: 'Regenerate restarts generation' and 'Pause holds output'.
kevin: Microcopy suggestion: use 'Pause'/'Resume' labels rather than 'Hold' to align with playback metaphors. For first-time users consider a one-time coachmark: 'Use Pause to freeze output while you review'.
jamie: Also: token counter placement — currently under the compose area. I think moving it into a slim status rail next to the stream control would reduce clutter. But ensure it's discoverable and keyboard accessible.
dennis: Token counter in the rail is doable. Also can expose breakdown (prompt / completion / cached) in a popover on click. Implementation note: prefer absolute positioned popover to avoid layout shift during streaming.
marta: Agreed on popover. Visual idea: token counter shows a small dot + number, chevron indicates click-to-expand. Hover text: 'tokens • click for breakdown / open prompt library'. Link to updated mock: https://figma.com/s/compact-rail-with-counter
kevin: One UX caveat: if token counter opens prompt library on click (quick-insert), that might surprise users expecting a breakdown. Maybe separate actions: click opens breakdown, small chevron opens prompt library. Or use a long-press on mobile.
jamie: For A11y: token counter must have role="button" and `aria-haspopup="dialog"` when it opens the breakdown. Ensure screen readers get 'Tokens: 742, press enter for more details' and when paused announce 'Streaming paused at token 142'.
marta: Design tweak: primary action layout — keep 'Regenerate' as left-aligned text button, compact controls (pause/resume, token counter, prompt quick-add) on the right so they don't compete visually.
dennis: Backend note: we already expose `reseed` param for regenerate path. Frontend should call regenerate with `reseed=true` to ensure fresh output.
kevin: Copy tweaks: replace vague 'Stop' with 'Pause' and use tooltip 'Pause streaming — resume from where it left off'. For regenerate tooltip: 'Regenerate from scratch'.
jamie: Accessibility action items: keyboard support (space/enter toggles), focus order checks, aria-live region updates for streaming chunks and finalization, contrast audit for icon colors. I'll draft the spec.
marta: Action items summary: Jamie — write A11y spec + example SR announcements; Dennis — prototype popover + absolute positioning; Kevin — microcopy updates and coachmark copy; Marta — push new Figma frames and finalize iconography. Target: EOD Friday for prototypes.
kevin: 👍 I'll also set up a small internal A/B with 5% of new Playground sessions to see if people miss the icon-only affordance. Low risk rollout.
design-bot: Auto-check: contrast audit flagged pause icon on gray-100 (proposed palette) as failing WCAG AA for 12px. Recommend increasing icon weight or using gray-700.
deploy-bot: Wireframe deploy scheduled for 3322150000 — ping if timeline needs shifting.
marta: Thanks all — will post updated frames tomorrow and link to the prototype.
